# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is a handsome young lady known for her real showy looks, which include a brilliant complexion and a plump, showy figure. She features large, bright-blue eyes and long yellow hair that can be worn flowing or in a braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she can be sentimental and prone to hysterics. She harbors a deep fear of caterpillars. Driven by a desire for romance, her goals center on having numerous suitors and enjoying a gay time before teaching briefly and settling down in marriage.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## Goals

- means to have a beau as soon as she’s fifteen  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- to teach for two years and then get married  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- wants to have many suitors when she grows up  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- to have dozens of beaus and a gay time before settling down (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>

## History

Growing up, Ruby Gillis charmed all her warts away using a magic pebble given to her by old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek, and she acquired a reputation for knowing a great deal about certain matters due to having many big sisters. As a child, she expressed a desire to have dozens of beaus when she grew up. She attended school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), eventually pursuing her education as a student who was liked by her peers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two share apples together at school, and Ruby forms part of the social group involved in creative pursuits such as writing stories.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), +6 more_

Ruby and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) are friends who regularly play and visit together. They share a close social circle of schoolmates involved in gatherings and group activities.

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a friend of [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). The two spend time together during midsummer afternoons playing games and participate in shared group events with their schoolmates.
